name: markdig
label: Markdig
stages: Native .NET Markdown.ToHtml with immutable pipeline configuration; complete parse/render to a fresh owned HTML string; normal workstation concurrent GC and tiered JIT/PGO enabled
boundary: This is a warmed .NET engine-core comparison, not AOT and not a Node wrapper. GC within a render window is timed; GC may also progress between windows. Collection/allocation counters are retained outside timing. Startup, fixture decoding and JIT warmup are excluded; timings measure steady-state render-window latency, not total process CPU.
